about.title: About me
paragraphs: I build what makes procurement and finance teams more effective: AI and Python tools that turn messy data into decisions, dashboards people act on, and automations that multiply what a small team can do.

My background is in supply chain (MSc, VU Amsterdam), with analyst roles close to the business: tenders and a data-driven pricing tool at C.H. Robinson, then advising the CFO with analytics at Tumble 'N Dry. At KPN, I moved from analysing procurement processes to building the solutions myself.
about.how: I use AI to cut through noise, not add to it, and to build and analyse at a scale I couldn't reach on my own. I keep the numbers trustworthy, and choose the simple solution that works over the perfect one that never arrives.

lines.title: Work line
lines.blurb: AI tools, dashboards and automations built at work

stations.name: Payment terms
stations.kicker: AI checked our contracts against the payment terms in our ERP.

stats.l: of euros in yearly spend paid earlier than agreed

did: Proposed the check as Procurement's representative in KPN's CFO working capital group.
Ran LLM extraction over the contract archive and compared the result with ERP master data.
Corrected terms with key suppliers and presented the results to the CFOs.

stations.name: Contract AI
stations.kicker: A Python tool that searches the contract archive by keyword or by meaning.
did: Plain matching where the hits are clear, an LLM where meaning matters.
ContractLens reads the archive once, then searches it in seconds.
Questions across the whole portfolio get answered at scale, not through a large manual effort.

stations.name: Procurement Radar
stations.kicker: The Power BI hub that procurement starts from.
did: Built and run the hub, from supplier, category and contract insights to a personal view for every buyer.
Managers get the same view for their team.
For the management team, AI writes the KPI analysis.

stations.name: Automations
stations.kicker: The automation layer that runs in the background.

stats.l: hours of manual work saved a month, estimated

did: Built and run Power Automate flows that integrate data and automate reporting.
Built Procurement Sonar, which shows the hidden automation as runs and hours saved.

stations.name: KPI analysis by AI
stations.kicker: A management KPI view where AI writes the analysis.
did: Built a self-service KPI overview with drill-down to the detail dashboards.
Every number comes straight from the BI model; the LLM only explains it.
Replaced the manual preparation of performance decks.

related.why: An engine supplies the numbers; AI only explains them

stations.name: Contract app
stations.kicker: Eagle Eye, a working contract-management app on top of ERP data.
did: Adds action and obligation tracking for contracts, suppliers and owners.
Reads ERP contract data and keeps its own actions, so the ERP stays the system of record.

stations.name: Price scraper
did: Built a Python web scraper that benchmarks market prices weekly.
Gives negotiations evidence to start from.

stations.name: Project tool
stations.kicker: The tool procurement tracks its projects and savings in.
did: Built the project management tool in Power Apps.
Added a one-click satisfaction survey: results go to the buyer and their manager and feed a dashboard.

stations.name: Agent platform
did: Built and run the infrastructure behind a Copilot Studio agent that routes questions to specialist sub-agents.
Help colleagues build their own sub-agents and set the quality bar for what joins the platform.

stations.name: Deck Forge
stations.kicker: An AI agent that turns an idea into a finished, on-brand presentation or animated explainer.
did: Idea in, deck or one-slide motion design out.
The outline is signed off first, and invented numbers are not allowed.

stations.name: Approval prediction
stations.kicker: A machine learning model that predicts how long a contract approval will take.
did: Trained on historical approval data and the variables that drive it.
Aim: better forecasts and fewer unexpected delays in the procurement process.

stations.name: Buying forecast
stations.kicker: An Excel model that predicts full-season buying needs from presales.
did: Analysed presales patterns to predict what to buy for the full season.
Reduced overstock and improved inventory turnover.

lines.title: Builds line
lines.blurb: Hardware and software I build at home

stations.name: Portable radar
stations.kicker: A mmWave radar that shows people moving around it, on a power bank.
did: An HLK-LD2450 radar sensor, an ESP32-S3 and a small TFT display, drawn as a classic radar scope.
Runs on a power bank, so it goes wherever I take it.
My first embedded project, finished in October 2026.

media.alt: The portable radar showing people as blips
media.caption: Photo follows

stations.name: Pala Note
stations.kicker: A voice recorder whose notes land in Obsidian.
did: An ESP32-S3 recorder, transcription on a Raspberry Pi, then sync to Obsidian.
A second pipeline reads handwritten reMarkable notes with OCR.
A 3D-printed enclosure with my JV monogram.

stations.name: ISS console
stations.kicker: Where the space station is, right now.
did: A Raspberry Pi 4 with a 7-inch touchscreen, in a Matrix theme.
Tracks the ISS in real time with SGP4 orbit calculations.

media.alt: The ISS console showing the station's track
media.caption: Photo follows

stations.name: Chess commentator
stations.kicker: A camera watches a real chessboard and commentates the game out loud.
did: An old iPhone films the board; computer vision recognises every move.
Each move goes to Stockfish; an LLM explains it from the pieces involved and the swing in evaluation.
The commentary is spoken with text-to-speech.

media.caption: Clip follows

stations.name: Desk focus buddy
stations.kicker: A small screen next to my monitor that shows the one task I'm on.
did: An ESP32 with a small screen in a 3D-printed case.
Send it a Telegram message and the task appears; mark it done and it clears for the next one.
Switchable screen styles, from a departure board to a growing plant, each with its own idle animation.
